aka.zh: 屏东—三地门段：县道 190 号（1962 年起）

tagline.en: From Pingtung city up the Ailiao valley to the Rukai villages of Wutai, the stub of a road once meant to cross the range to Taitung, rebuilt after Typhoon Morakot over a bridge on a 74 m pier
tagline.zh: 自屏东市沿隘寮溪谷上至雾台鲁凯族部落，是一条原本要翻越中央山脉通往台东的道路残段；莫拉克台风后以一座桥墩高 74 米的大桥重建

start.en: Pingtung city, at Provincial Highway 3 on Jianguo Road
start.zh: 屏东市建国路，衔接台 3 线

end.en: Ali, Wutai, Pingtung; the drivable road ends at Jilu, the last 3 km being a temporary road
end.zh: 屏东县雾台乡阿礼；可通行道路止于吉露，最后约 3 公里为临时便道

en: Provincial Highway 24 runs 47.473 km east from Pingtung city past the Changzhi interchange on Freeway 3, through Yanpu and Neipu to Sandimen at the mouth of the mountains, about 20.8 km. At the Sande checkpoint, about 26.5 km, it enters the controlled mountain area, and climbs the Ailiao North river valley to Wutai at about 39.4 km and on to Jilu at about 44.5 km. The last stretch to Ali is the temporary road Lin 45.
It is the road into Wutai township, home of the Rukai people. After Typhoon Morakot in 2009 the villages of Jilu and Ali, at its upper end, were relocated.
zh: 台 24 线全长 47.473 公里，自屏东市向东，经国道 3 号长治交流道、盐埔、内埔，至约 20.8 公里处山口的三地门。约 26.5 公里的三德检查哨是进入山地管制区的入口，其后沿隘寮北溪谷地爬升，至约 39.4 公里的雾台，再至约 44.5 公里的吉露；吉露至阿礼最后一段为临 45 线临时便道。
这是进入鲁凯族聚居的雾台乡的道路。2009 年莫拉克台风后，位于路线上端的吉露、阿礼两部落迁村。

en: The Japanese built a road from the Pingtung side over the Chi saddle, at 1,682 m, to Zhiben in Taitung. It was passable on foot by 1930 and completed on 10 March 1945, about 120 km long; the governor-general's office said that keeping it open would be hard.

After the war Pingtung–Sandimen became County Road 190 in 1962. A survey was made in 1975, and in 1978 the road was numbered Provincial Highway 22, planned east to Zhiben. Paving of 48 km began in 1988 and took three years; on the Taitung side the Forestry Bureau restored 24.2 km of the Zhiben forest road, of which 11.9 km is passable. In 1993 the road was renumbered 24, the number 22 going to a Kaohsiung road. On 28 March 2011 an Executive Yuan announcement struck off the unbuilt section from Ali to Zhiben.

Typhoon Morakot in August 2009 cut Wutai off. Debris buried the 54 m Yila bridge some 20 m deep and widened the river from 54 m to over 200 m, and there were more than 20 collapses between 28 and 48 km. On 11 August 2009 a National Airborne Service Corps UH-1H helicopter supplying the villages crashed in the valley about 1 km west of Yila, killing its three crew; the Aviation Safety Council found it had struck unmarked wires of an abandoned cableway.
zh: 日治时期修筑了自屏东越过海拔 1,682 米的尺鞍部至台东知本的道路，1930 年已可步行，1945 年 3 月 10 日完成，全长约 120 公里；总督府称其维护困难。
战后屏东至三地门段于 1962 年编为县道 190 号。1975 年进行勘测，1978 年编为台 22 线，规划东延至知本。1988 年起分三年铺设 48 公里路面；台东一侧由林务局修复知本林道 24.2 公里，其中 11.9 公里可通行。1993 年改编为台 24 线，台 22 线编号让予高雄的一条道路。2011 年 3 月 28 日行政院公告，废止未修通的阿礼至知本段。

2009 年 8 月莫拉克台风使雾台对外交通断绝。土石掩埋长 54 米的伊拉桥约 20 米深，河道由 54 米扩宽至 200 米以上，28 至 48 公里间崩塌逾 20 处。2009 年 8 月 11 日，内政部空中勤务总队一架 UH-1H 直升机在伊拉以西约 1 公里的河谷执行物资运补时坠毁，机上三名机组人员殉职；飞航安全调查委员会认定该机撞上未设标志的废弃索道钢索。殉职者为张顺发、王宗立、黄镁智。

en: The rebuilt road crosses the valley on the Wutai Guchuan bridge, 654 m long and 10 m wide, a prestressed concrete box girder in nine spans with a single pier in the river channel. Its tallest pier, P3, is 74 m high (80 m with the girder), the deck 99 m above the foundations, and the main span 140 m; the well foundations go down 35 m. It was built by falsework, balanced cantilever and movable scaffolding, and the contractor reported 1,023 days without a lost-time accident.

Work began on 13 December 2010 under the directorate's Third District office, and the contract was closed on 9 August 2013. The bridge opened on 5 October 2013, together with a memorial to those who died in the Morakot relief, on a viewing platform at the Sandimen end. Other contracts rebuilt the road between 24 and 41 km and added a rock shed at 29.5 km.
zh: 重建后的道路以雾台谷川大桥跨越河谷。桥长 654 米，宽 10 米，为九跨预力混凝土箱型梁，河道中只设一座桥墩。最高的 P3 桥墩高 74 米（连梁高 80 米），桥面距基础 99 米，主跨 140 米，沉箱基础深 35 米。施工采用满堂支撑、平衡悬臂与移动支撑三种工法，承包商称连续 1,023 天无失能伤害。
工程由公路总局第三区养护工程处主办，2010 年 12 月 13 日开工，2013 年 8 月 9 日结案。大桥于 2013 年 10 月 5 日通车，同日在三地门端景观平台揭幕八八风灾救灾英雄纪念碑。其余标案重建了 24 至 41 公里路段，并在 29.5 公里处增设落石棚。

en: No cost is published for the road as built in the 1980s. The Morakot reconstruction is priced: Highway 24 received nearly NT$1.7 billion from the Morakot special budget, about NT$730 million of it for the Guchuan bridge, whose construction contract was NT$720.98 million.
zh: 1980 年代修筑时的造价未见公布。莫拉克灾后重建则有明确金额：台 24 线获莫拉克特别预算近 17 亿元，其中约 7.3 亿元用于谷川大桥；大桥工程由光顺营造承揽，契约金额 7.2098 亿元。

en: Speed limits are 30 to 60 km/h. The Sande checkpoint marks the entry to the controlled mountain area. Past Jilu the road gives way to the temporary road to Ali.
zh: 全线限速每小时 30 至 60 公里。三德检查哨是山地管制区的入口。过吉露后，道路转为通往阿礼的临时便道。

why.en: No cost has been published for the 1980s road; only the Morakot reconstruction is priced, listed below.
why.zh: 1980 年代道路的造价未见公布；只有莫拉克灾后重建有金额，另列如下。

value.en: Morakot reconstruction: nearly NT$1.7 billion from the central government's Morakot special budget
value.zh: 莫拉克重建：中央政府莫拉克台风灾后重建特别预算近 17 亿元

figures.source: Morakot Post-Disaster Reconstruction Council, reported by Central News Agency, 3 October 2013

value.en: Contract NT$720.98 million; about NT$730 million in all; 654 m long, main span 140 m, tallest pier 74 m; opened 5 October 2013
value.zh: 契约金额 7.2098 亿元，总经费约 7.3 亿元；桥长 654 米，主跨 140 米，最高桥墩 74 米；2013 年 10 月 5 日通车

figures.source: DGH Third District Maintenance Office project record; Morakot Post-Disaster Reconstruction Council via Central News Agency, 3 October 2013; Presidential Office news release, 5 October 2013

value.en: 47.473 km to Ali; drivable to Jilu at about 44.5 km
value.zh: 至阿礼 47.473 公里；可通行至约 44.5 公里的吉露

figures.source: Directorate General of Highways route list, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 台24線

label.zh: NA-502 直升机失事（2009 年 8 月 11 日）

value.en: Three crew killed; struck unmarked wires of an abandoned cableway
value.zh: 三名机组人员殉职；撞上未设标志的废弃索道钢索

figures.source: Aviation Safety Council (now Taiwan Transportation Safety Board) investigation report

timeline.en: The Japanese road over the Chi saddle to Zhiben is completed on 10 March, about 120 km.
timeline.zh: 3 月 10 日，日治时期越过尺鞍部至知本的道路完成，约 120 公里。
屏东至三地门段编为县道 190 号。

timeline.en: The road is numbered Provincial Highway 22, planned east to Zhiben.
timeline.zh: 编为台 22 线，规划东延至知本。

timeline.en: Three years of paving begin on 48 km.
timeline.zh: 开始分三年铺设 48 公里路面。

timeline.en: Typhoon Morakot cuts Wutai off; a relief helicopter crashes in the valley on 11 August.
timeline.zh: 莫拉克台风使雾台对外交通断绝；8 月 11 日，救灾直升机在河谷坠毁。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Wutai Guchuan bridge on 13 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 13 日，雾台谷川大桥开工。

timeline.en: On 28 March the unbuilt Ali–Zhiben section is struck off.
timeline.zh: 3 月 28 日，未修通的阿礼至知本段废止。

timeline.en: The Guchuan bridge opens on 5 October with a memorial to the Morakot relief dead.
timeline.zh: 10 月 5 日，谷川大桥通车，八八风灾救灾英雄纪念碑同日揭幕。
